## Project scope

This project develops a transparent genomic-selection workflow for papaya
using multi-allelic SSR markers. It compares Bayesian ridge regression, BayesA,
BayesB, BayesB under the article's `pi = 1e-5` convention, BayesC, Bayesian
Lasso, RR-BLUP, and GBLUP. BGLR implements the Bayesian models
[-@perez2014bglr], while `rrBLUP::mixed.solve` implements the frequentist
ridge and genomic BLUP models [-@endelman2011rrblup].

Predictive comparison is based on the same family-stratified eight folds for
all models. DIC is retained only as an internal Bayesian-model diagnostic; it
is not used to compare Bayesian fits against RR-BLUP or GBLUP.

## Escopo do projeto

O projeto desenvolve um fluxo transparente de seleção genômica para mamoeiro
com marcadores SSR multialélicos. São comparados regressão ridge Bayesiana,
BayesA, BayesB, BayesB segundo a convenção `pi = 1e-5` do artigo, BayesC, Lasso
Bayesiano, RR-BLUP e GBLUP.

A comparação preditiva usa os mesmos oito folds estratificados por família em
todos os modelos. O DIC permanece como diagnóstico interno aos modelos
Bayesianos e não é empregado para compará-los com RR-BLUP ou GBLUP.

## Important analytical decisions / Decisões analíticas importantes

- Individual IDs come from `Genealex!Ind`; the first `Genes` column is not
  interpreted as family.
- SSRs are represented by allele dosages, retaining triallelic information.
- Imputation, centering, and genomic-relationship construction are estimated
  from training individuals within each fold.
- Block and family are categorical fixed effects.
- Trait-specific rankings are reported. A multi-trait selection index is
  deferred until the breeding program defines directions and economic weights.
